summary.text: Rolanda Hollis is a Democratic state representative from Alabama House District 58 who took office in 2017 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election. Hollis was born and raised in Birmingham, holds an accounting degree from Tuskegee University, and worked as a real estate broker.

paragraphs.text: Hollis was born and raised in Birmingham and graduated from Huffman High School before earning a bachelor of science in accounting from Tuskegee University.
She worked as a real estate broker.
Hollis assumed office in the Alabama House in 2017.

In the 2025-2026 session Hollis was vice chair of the Jefferson County Legislation Committee and served on the Economic Development and Tourism; Transportation, Utilities and Infrastructure; and Ports, Waterways and Intermodal Transit committees.
